privileged_info_for_vlm: The employee 'Anita Oliver' is an 'Experienced Developer' in the 'R&D USA' department. The badge must be printed using the Odoo 'Print' -> 'Badge' menu option. The final file must be located at /home/ga/badge.pdf; it initially downloads to /home/ga/Downloads.
